item.title: Arnold Rosner’s Music for Wind Band: Bold and Unfiltered — Charlottesville Classical
item.description: Density512 is a first-rate ensemble, dedicated to contemporary music. They play with commitment, expression, and enthusiasm. Arnold Rosner was truly a unique composer with a voice all his own.

item.title: #ClassicsaDay #PoetryMonth Week 5 2025 — Charlottesville Classical
item.description: The Classics a Day challenge for April is to post examples of classical music inspired by poetry. The most obvious cases are poems set to music. But sometimes, inspiration runs deeper.

item.title: Les Kapsber’girls — Vox Feminae — Charlottesville Classical
item.description: These works are not presented as academic curiosities. This is a program filled with exciting and engaging performances.

item.title: #ClassicsaDay #ClassicalMexico Week 1, 2025 — Charlottesville Classical
item.description: Our neighbor to the south has a long, rich history of classical music. A much longer history than ours, in fact. For May, the Classics a Day team encourages folks to post videos of Mexican classical music.

item.title: Miklos Rozsa: Sinfonia concertante — Charlottesville Classical
item.description: Gregor Buhl directs the Deutsche Staatsphilharmoni Rheinland-Pfalz. Their playing is disciplined with a concentrated power that matches the soloists.

item.title: Ralph Graves, longtime WTJU classical host, passes away — Charlottesville Classical
